title: Counter Clash
description:
A fast-paced RTS where strategies and tactics, not build orders, decide the outcome. Rapidly build cities and command armies in explosive tactical battles without the usual grind.

Counter your opponents with well-timed troops or upgrades. Can’t break through their fortifications? Deploy the giants! Having a hard time with those pesky priest heals? Upgrade Poisoned Tips to let them rot!

Customise your armies with over 40 unique upgrades. Are you a turtle? Have your castle shoot bombs, or your merchants greet their harassers with a rain of arrows! Aggressive much? Deploy troops directly on the frontline with parachutes or redirect their projectiles with hurricanes!

• Crush enemies with holy armies. Monceaux is a kingdom of valiant knights and warriors. Their versatile troops, strong siege engines, and holy healing ways are easy to learn but hard to master.

• Overwhelm with elemental chaos. Fahad is a nomadic culture that harnesses the power of ancient elements. Take to the battlefield with fast, high-damage troops and impactful magics.

• Outgun them with industrial firepower. The URA are a republic of scientists and engineers. What they lack in speed and defence, they compensate for with tactical superiority and sheer firepower!

Conquer a campaign with a wild cast of questionable characters, or jump into battle mode and see how long you last against an army of elementals. 

• Campaign Mode: Guide a paranoid king, a lost shaman, and a grumpy general as they rampage over the lands with ever-changing loyalties.

• Battle Mode: Create one-off skirmishes against up to three AI-controlled armies across multiple maps, from a simple river crossing to active volcanoes.

• Testing Grounds: Test your tactics against armies of any size! Money is no object in Test Grounds, so build up your and your enemy's forces, and let combat commence in battles with endless possibilities.
description_short: A fast-paced RTS where your decisions, not optimal builds, decide the outcome. Jump straight into explosive battles, adapt on the fly, and outplay your enemies in the heat of combat.
